verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents reusable building blocks that many agents can share: skills (reusable instructions, optionally with templates and scripts), an organization-wide skill library synced to GitHub, and custom hosted MCP servers that act as reusable tool modules. None of these is shown to be a sub-workflow or module that other workflows call inside a visual builder. Missing for 10: documented sub-workflow/subflow nodes in the visual builder, workflow-to-workflow invocation with inputs/outputs, versioning of reusable modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
